name: Netlify
description: Inspect and deploy Netlify sites, with their builds, env vars and logs.
long_description:
Netlify's hosted server, connected to your team. It lists sites, reads build and deploy logs, manages environment variables and can trigger a deploy.

Deploying changes what the public sees, so those tools are confirmed every time whatever the chat's mode says.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Netlify in your browser and choose what this chat may reach.

risk.notes: Reaches your Netlify team. Deploying is confirmed every time: it changes what the public sees.
